title: Super easy to get started
text: Super easy to enroll. I had a good time at the gym and I could even attend to the classes with the Fitness Pass from Boddy. It's super flexible. You don't have to pay a monthly fee, you can just go whenever you feel like and then you purchase a package.
author: 420esmeed

title: Great pass!
text: I used this voucher at Smartfit in Barcelona. The staff there were lovely and even though they were not yet familiar about this pass, they still welcomed me into their gym to keep my fitness and training up whilst travelling.
author: 534francesb

title: Trustworthy solution
text: Good selection of gyms/venus. some gyms offered spa and sauna. process was quite simple: i just had to go to the gym of my choice, open the boddy app and click on "check in". friendly staff in the gyms I visited.
author: 7SergioSanchez7

title: A great complement for a trip to the city
text:
This was the first time I was confronted with this Wellness/Fitness Passes. Enjoyed the offering in Barcelona... then went on to try their pass in Madrid when visiting the city with friends. 
Some really cool venues (including swimming pools and spa, outdoor training on the beach,...) 
A great complement for a trip to the city
author: Sergio S

title: Brilliant!
text: Great experience, easily accessible, great support team as well 🙌 will be using at more of my travels!
author: jordanpZ8551TL
